command.name: security key-manager external barbican check
command.description: This command displays the Barbican Key Management Service (KMS) status.

parameter.name: node
parameter.description: If this parameter is specified then the command displays only the Barbican status for the given node.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: If this parameter is specified then the command displays only the Barbican status for the given Vserver.

parameter.name: category
parameter.description:
If this parameter is specified then the command displays only the Barbican status for the given category.
Category Description -------- ----------- Status Status of the Barbican Key Management Service Details Detailed description of the status

parameter.name: status
parameter.description:
If this parameter is specified then the command displays only the Barbican status entries matching the given status.
OK FAILED UNKNOWN

parameter.name: detail
parameter.description: This field displays the detailed status message, if available.

example.p: The example below displays the status of all components of all Barbican configurations enabled on the node.
example.screen:
cluster-1::> security key-manager external barbican check Vserver: vsSample1 Node: nodeSample Category: service_reachability Status: OK Details: OK
Category: kms_wrapped_key_status Status: OK Details: OK
Vserver: vsSample2 Node: nodeSample
Category: service_reachability Status: OK Details: OK
Category: kms_wrapped_key_status Status: OK Details: OK 4 entries were displayed.
